mechanics.claim: Dr. Mundo gains a one-time immunity to the next hostile immobilizing effect, and only resisting that triggers the health cost and canister drop.
mechanics.quote: Dr. Mundo gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a {{as|health cost}} equal to {{as|4% of his '''current''' health}}

mechanics.claim: Immunity extends to additional immobilizing effects from the same cast instance once triggered.
mechanics.quote: Upon being triggered by a hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, ''Goes Where He Pleases'' will also grant '''Dr. Mundo''' immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same {{tip|cast instance}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shields and Black Shield-type effects take priority over this passive's immunity.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} and {{ai|Black Shield|Morgana}} take priority over ''Goes Where He Pleases''.

mechanics.claim: The passive's cooldown resets when Dr. Mundo respawns.
mechanics.quote: ''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].
